description: This file defines syntax highlighting mode for the CodeMirror editor for the D programming language, including tokenization rules, syntax highlighting styles, and MIME type configuration.

classes.name: Context
classes.description: Represents a parsing context for indentation and scope management in the syntax highlighter.

methods.name: tokenBase
methods.description: Performs tokenization of the code stream, identifying keywords, operators, strings, comments, and variables.

methods.name: tokenString
methods.description: Handles string literal tokenization, supporting multi-line strings and escape sequences.

methods.name: pushContext
methods.description: Pushes a new parsing context onto the context stack.

methods.name: popContext
methods.description: Pops the current parsing context from the context stack.
